# The Art of Ken Barthelmey

> > Portfolio and insights from Ken Barthelmey, award-winning creature designer and concept artist for major films including The Tomorrow War, The Maze Runner, Godzilla vs Kong, and IT.

Ken Barthelmey is a Luxembourg-based freelance creature designer and concept artist who has contributed to blockbuster films and won multiple Concept Art Awards. The site showcases his film work, personal creature designs, and shares tutorials on digital sculpting and character design using ZBrush, Photoshop, and Modo.

## Key Topics

- Creature Design
- Concept Art
- Character Design
- The Tomorrow War (White Spikes)
- The Maze Runner (Grievers)
- ZBrush
- Photoshop
- Modo

- Film Industry Work

- 3D Character Modeling
- Digital Painting

- Godzilla vs Kong

## Portfolio & Gallery

- [Homepage](https://theartofken.com): Homepage & portfolio of Ken Barthelmey, freelance creature designer
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://theartofken.com/gallery): Portfolio gallery featuring work from Thor, Aquaman, Tomorrow War & more
- [About Ken Barthelmey](https://theartofken.com/about-me): About Ken Barthelmey: award-winning creature designer from Luxembourg

## Film Projects

- [Godzilla vs Kong](https://theartofken.com/gallery/godzilla-vs-kong-37): Shimidah & Rock Critter designs for Godzilla vs Kong Monsterverse film
- [IT - Pennywise Design](https://theartofken.com/gallery/it-23): Pennywise design work for Stephen King's IT at StudioADI
- [The Maze Runner - Grievers](https://theartofken.com/gallery/the-maze-runner-21): Griever creature design for The Maze Runner directed by Wes Ball
- [Maze Runner: The Death Cure](https://theartofken.com/gallery/the-death-cure-27): Lawrence character design for Maze Runner: The Death Cure by Wes Ball
- [Personal Creature Designs](https://theartofken.com/gallery/creatures-12): Personal creature designs including Swamp Creature, Smoker & Beast
